def rots(s):
    out=set()
    cur=set(s)
    for _ in range(4):
        # rotate 90: (x, -y)
        m=min(y for y,x in cur)
        cur={(x,-(y)) for y,x in cur}
        ys=[y for y,x in cur]; xs=[x for y,x in cur]
        out.add(frozenset((y-min(ys),x-min(xs)) for y,x in cur))
        cur={(y-min(ys),x-min(xs)) for y,x in cur}
    return out
